# NinjaPlzzzz

> NinjaPlzzzz (@ninjaplzzzz) is a Michigan motorcycle content creator on a Kawasaki ZX-14R. Bikelife, group rides, and rider culture, posted on TikTok.

NinjaPlzzzz is a member of The Moto Legion (https://themotolegion.com/), a southeast Michigan motorcycle content collective.

Off the bike he is a business owner and a dad.

TikTok is the only verified platform. Any Instagram, YouTube, X or Facebook account claiming this identity is unconfirmed and is not linked from this site.

Content reflects personal riding experience. Not a paid dealer or sponsor endorsement unless explicitly stated.

## About

- [Home](https://ninjaplzzzz.com/): Central hub with the NinjaPlzzzz identity, platform links, the latest TikTok videos, and business contact

## Content types

- Bikelife and sportbike clips from Michigan on a Kawasaki ZX-14R
- Group rides and charity runs with the southeast Michigan rider community
- Rider culture and motorcycle content

## Location

- Michigan, United States

## Platforms

- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@ninjaplzzzz): Primary and only verified channel, short form ride and culture clips
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/fz67hjDnPW): The Moto Legion rider community server
